item.title: Hyundai shows off the ultimate EV camper with solar power, a kitchen, and few other goodies
item.description: Hyundai unveiled an all-electric camper van with solar panels for off-grid adventures. It even has a kitchen, smart features, and plenty more for extended stays. more…

item.title: Kia launches the EV4 in Australia and it’s cheaper than a Tesla Model 3
item.description: Kia launched the EV4 in Australia, where it will go head-to-head with the Tesla Model 3 and Chinese EV brands, including BYD. The EV4 is cheaper than a Model 3, but BYD’s prices still beat it. more…

item.title: Coal use dropped in China and India in 2025. It rose in USA, hiking energy costs.
item.description: Coal experienced a historic decline in China and India, the world’s two most populous countries, in 2025, marking the first time in 52 years that both countries have seen a decline in coal generation at the same time. Meanwhile, the world’s largest historical polluter, the US, ticked up its use of the worst method of power generation, which coincided with higher energy costs amid an affordability crisis. more…

item.title: Toyota is launching its first EV in India tomorrow, and it’s a new midsize electric SUV
item.description: The Urban Cruiser EV is arriving as Toyota’s first all-electric vehicle in India. With prices expected to start at around Rs 19 lakh ($21,000), the entry-level EV will compete in the heart of India’s booming electric SUV market. more…

item.title: Big in Japan: FedEx adds electric box vans to last-mile delivery fleet
item.description: Logistics and delivery giant FedEx is deploying 17 new electric box trucks in a move that advanced the company’s global electrification plans and Japan’s national climate targets, which focus on densely populated urban areas. more…

item.title: Kia has a new halo EV in the works, and this is our best look at it
item.description: Kia is pushing ahead with plans for yet another EV, but this one will be unique as a new flagship halo model. We already have a good idea of what it will look like. more…

item.title: The Genesis GV90 may not come with coach doors at first
item.description: The GV90 will be the largest, most lavish Genesis vehicle to date, but after another delay, the ultra-luxe SUV may be missing one of its most hyped features. In recent sightings, the GV90 is missing its Rolls-Royce-style coach doors. more…

item.title: Germany is using heated bricks to replace gas-fired industrial boilers
item.description: Rondo Energy and Covestro broke ground on a new kind of industrial heat battery at Covestro’s Brunsbüttel chemical site in northern Germany, and it’s designed to do something industry desperately needs: make clean, reliable steam without burning fossil fuels. more…

item.title: Wawa now has its own self-branded Tesla Superchargers
item.description: Wawa, the biggest Tesla Supercharger host, has joined Tesla’s Supercharger for Business program and launched its first self-branded site. more…
